results.rationale: Consistency: package identities and wooden setting remain recognizable, but the small eraser is reduced and shifted, and background wood/objects change. Instruction: the left eraser remains substantially taller and wider than the right, while the right is also shrunk; the requested size match is not achieved. Quality: both packages retain coherent shapes, readable product lettering and natural shadows.

Consistency: the white background, intact left chopstick and upper brown portions remain unchanged. Instruction: the missing lower handle of the right chopstick is completed to approximately the proper length, but it is brown instead of matching the cream handle of its partner. Quality: both sticks have clean continuous geometry, plausible texture and subtle shadows without conspicuous artifacts.
